title.narrative: Focused Surveillance Strategy and DTIR to support the national goal of Malaria Elimination

description.narrative: Honduras - Malaria - Cooperative Housing Foundation - CHF. This program has the following goals: Cero casos autoctonos de Malaria en el año 2022 / Cero indigenous malaria cases in 2022. The objectives of this program are: Desarrollar un solido sistema de vigilancia en el nivel local (microestratificación), subnacional y nacional de malaria. / Develop a robust malaria surveillance system at the local (microstratification), sub-national and national levels.. Garantizar cobertura universal y calidad del diagnostico, tratamiento e investigación de casos y focos. / Guarantee universal coverage and quality of diagnosis, treatment and investigation of cases and foci.. Promover el manejo integrado de vectores diferenciado por estrato epidemiologico / Promote integrated vector management differentiated by epidemiological strata.. Fortalecer el papel del Sistema de Salud, incluido el papel de la comunidad. / Strengthen the role of the Health System, including the role of the community.
